Name: Matcha Gotcha
Effect: Projectile Move. Accuracy -1. The User restores HP equal to half the damage dealt, rounded down. Roll 2 Chance Dice to inflict Burn (1) on the Target. If the user is affected by Frostbite, destroy the ice block.
Description: The user invites the foe to a herbal tea ceremony. As the tea is served and the foe is off guard, the user throws the hot tea on them, then proceeds to enjoy their own cup.
